business_overview.one_sentence: The group is primarily engaged in the sale of software, hardware and system integration, with small rental income from investment properties.

segments.name: Sale of software, hardware and system integration
segments.business_substance: Main operating business; goods transferred at a point in time.

segments.name: Rental income from investment property operating leases

business_overview.revenue_model: System integration and software/hardware sales are mainly credit sales; payment is generally due within 90 days, and some contracts contain retention receivables.
business_notes: The group operates primarily in Mainland China and Hong Kong.
No single external customer accounted for 10% or more of revenue in 2025.
At 31 December 2025, major contracts in hand amounted to approximately HKD285.1 million and were expected to be completed within one year.

non_recurring_items.business_substance: Treasury return, not operating customer revenue.
Software-related PRC grants recognised in other income.

non_recurring_items.item: Fair value losses on investment properties
non_recurring_items.business_substance: Non-cash fair value change on investment properties.

non_recurring_items.item: Reversal of impairment of entrusted loan
non_recurring_items.business_substance: Recovery/reversal linked to historical Peking Founder entrusted loan restructuring.
Disposal loss, not recurring operating profit.

funds_assets.business_substance: Cash at banks; earns floating daily bank deposit rates.
Short-term time deposits, varying between seven days and six months.
Pledged for long-term and short-term letters of guarantee.
RMB cash/equivalents; RMB not freely convertible but can be exchanged through authorised banks.

operating_assets.business_substance: Finished goods and work in progress.
Credit sales receivables; generally due within 90 days.
Retention receivables and amounts conditional on delivery/acceptance.
Land and buildings, office equipment, machinery and vehicles.

investment_assets.business_substance: Properties held for rental income/capital appreciation.
investment_assets.source: Annual Report 2025 statement of financial position and note 13

investment_assets.business_substance: Listed PUC Berhad shares designated strategic.

other_assets.business_substance: Prepayments, rental deposits and deposits with customers, net of impairment.

financing_liabilities.business_substance: Current HKD1.266m plus non-current HKD0.427m lease liabilities.
financing_liabilities.source: Annual Report 2025 statement of financial position
Annual Report 2025 management discussion and analysis

operating_liabilities.business_substance: Supplier payables normally settled in 30 to 90 days.
Short-term advances for software, hardware and system integration.
Accrued salaries, subcontracting fee, tax payables and other accruals.

other_liabilities.business_substance: Minimum tax exposure recorded as non-current tax liabilities.
other_liabilities.source: Annual Report 2025 note 10 and statement of financial position
